prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent idle boss sprite for Maple-inspired 2D RPG lab.
Primary request: Create one crisp pixel-art Aeonblight Drake based on attached references.
Input images: first is final rendered full-body flying appearance; second is final official orthographic design with front/side/back and wing assemblies. Use second for grounded side anatomy. This is NOT the earlier four-legged concept.
Subject: one mechanical ruin dragon in a relaxed grounded bipedal stance, facing left in a three-quarter side view. Keep its stocky dark brown armored torso, pale stone-gray layered armor, orange triangular accents, mechanical horned snout with golden star-shaped face core, two thick jointed hind legs with broad block claw feet, long thin segmented tail curling behind to right and ending in a large hollow gear ring. Two separate shoulder-mounted mechanical wing pods, each with orange-centered star/ring hub and paired long narrow metal blades with orange inlays. Wings angled backward and partly folded for idle, no firing. Keep both feet visible and planted on one baseline, tail ring clear of feet.
Style: crisp pixel art with substantial clusters and dark colored outlines, limited stone-gray/dark brown/orange palette. Strong silhouette and visible orange cores at 180 pixels tall and 90 pixels tall. Simplify tiny engravings and bolts but preserve separate wing pods and hollow ring tail. No smooth gradients, blur, dithering or noisy texture.
Composition: entire subject including wings and tail inside transparent margins. Idle only, no rockets/flames/sparks/missiles/attacks, rocks, terrain, shadow, text, UI or multiple copies. Actual alpha transparency. One finished sprite, no sprite sheet. Do not make a four-legged animal or organic bat wings.
